name: Actor
summary: Who took a step: ``kind`` "person" or "agent"; ``name``, the person's login or the agent's client as it names itself (blank if unknown); ``via``, the interface: "app", "python" (scripts and notebooks) or "mcp".

name: api
summary: Make a public function or method a recorded call (see the module docstring). ``id`` defaults to ``plugin:class.method`` in lower case (``pymetrix:equation.fit``). ``show(arguments)`` names arguments that generated code writes even at their default (``vintag…

name: AppInterface
summary: The desktop app as a plugin's panel sees it.

name: AppPanel
summary: A docked panel: its title, ``create(app) -> QWidget`` and where it docks first (left, right or bottom).

name: build_mcp_server
summary: The MCP server over ``session`` (a new ``Session`` by default), allowed what ``policy`` allows.

name: call_migration
summary: Register a function turning a call's arguments saved at ``from_version`` into those of the next version.

name: check_cancelled
summary: Stop the running step here if Cancel was pressed.

name: Command
summary: Base class for commands. Subclasses are dataclasses registered with ``@command``.

name: command
summary: Register a command class under a menu path such as ``"Estimate/Equation..."`` (``None``: not in the menus, but saved in projects and replayed). ``id`` (or the class's ``command_id``) fixes its identifier in projects; the default is ``plugin:snake_name``.

name: Diagnostic
summary: A problem in the text: where it is (line and column from 1), what it is, and how bad.

name: eviews_blank_comments
summary: Comments (``'`` to the end of the line, outside double quotes) replaced by spaces: positions stay.

name: eviews_statements
summary: Each statement and its offset; a line ending in `` _`` continues on the next (same length: offsets stay).

name: EViewsBinary
summary: ``left op right``: an arithmetic operator (``+ - * / ^``) or a comparison (``< > <= >= <> =``).

name: EViewsBrackets
summary: ``x`` in brackets, as written.

name: EViewsCall
summary: A function call: ``fn`` as written in lower case (``"dlog"``, ``"@pch"``) and its argument nodes.

name: EViewsCoefficient
summary: A coefficient ``vector(index)``, such as ``c(2)``.

name: EViewsExpressionError
summary: Text the reader refuses: why, and where (an offset in the document, and how many characters).

name: EViewsName
summary: A series or scalar ``name`` (lower case) at ``lag`` (negative: a lag, positive: a lead), spanning ``length`` characters from ``at``.

name: EViewsNegative
summary: A minus sign before ``x``.

name: EViewsNumber
summary: A number as written (``text``), at offset ``at``.

name: ExampleDataset
summary: An example dataset a plugin ships: ``Dataset.example(name)`` reads the Parquet file at ``path``. ``path`` may be any path-like object; ``os.fspath`` is called on it only when the dataset is loaded, so it can download data the plugin may not redistribute int…

name: figure_views
summary: A "Graph" tab, if the object can be drawn (and matplotlib is installed).

name: line_and_column
summary: The line and column (both from 1) of an offset (from 0) in ``text``.

name: make_call
summary: The ``Call`` of ``call_id`` on ``receiver`` (for methods) with ``arguments``, defaults applied, as recording the call would give: how dialogs build the call they run. Name workspace objects with ``Ref("data")``; a ``Call`` as the receiver, an argument or a…

name: MCPPolicy
summary: What the server may do beyond estimation: run Python code, write files, fetch network data, and where files may be read or written (``root`` and below).

name: MenuLayout
summary: The order of a plugin's own top menu: command class names, None for a separator, and (title, [entries]) for a submenu, as ``pymetrix.commands.menus.MENU_LAYOUT``. A plugin's dialogs in the core menus go at their end.

name: migration
summary: Register a function that turns a step's fields saved at ``from_version`` into those of ``from_version + 1``::

name: numerical_hessian
summary: Central-difference Hessian of a scalar function.

name: parse_eviews_expression
summary: One EViews expression as a tree of nodes whose offsets are ``base`` plus the text's own; ``vectors`` are the coefficient vectors (``{"c"}`` at least); ``comparison`` lets the whole be a comparison. ``_Refused`` where it does not read.

name: plugin_context
summary: Registrations inside the block belong to ``info``.

name: PluginInfo
signature: PluginInfo(name, version, api='1.10', requires=<factory>, license='', maintainer='', description='', install='')
summary: Who provides a set of extensions, what they need, and under which licence.

name: random_number_generator
summary: A NumPy ``Generator`` from ``seed`` (an integer, a sequence of them, a ``SeedSequence`` or None), with the bit generator chosen by ``set_random_generator`` (or ``name``). A Generator is returned as it is. With the default ``"pcg64"`` this is exactly ``np.ra…

name: Ref
summary: A reference to an object by its name in a session (a dataset, a fitted equation...), not a copy of it.

name: register
signature: register(group, obj=None, name=None, label=None, kind=None, requires=None, preset=None, plugin=None)
summary: Register ``obj`` in ``group``; usable as a decorator (``@register("filters")``).

name: register_view
summary: Register ``fn(obj) -> [(title, Table), ...]``: the tabs of an object window for result type ``cls``.

name: renamed_arguments
summary: Accept keyword arguments by their old names (old=new), with a DeprecationWarning; both names at once raise a SpecificationError (also a TypeError). Put it above ``@api``, so the call is recorded under the new names; saved calls with the old names need a ``c…

name: render_eviews_expression
summary: A parsed expression (``_parse``) as pymetrix's text, as ``convert_expression`` writes it; ``_Refused`` (with the place) where it does not translate. Public as ``pymetrix.extension.render_eviews_expression``. ``data``: an expression for data work (the data's…

name: report_progress
summary: How far the running step is (0 to 1) and, optionally, what it is doing; stops it if Cancel was pressed.

name: ReportNote
summary: A line about each result a report exports (extension API 1.6): ``note(session, name)`` returns the line for the result called ``name``, or None for none. The lines go under ``heading``, before the appendix.

name: ReportTemplate
summary: A named report layout: which views of each result to include, in order, and whether to add provenance.

name: SessionEvent
signature: SessionEvent(kind, session, records=(), code='', path='', during='work', detail=<factory>, time=<factory>, actor=<factory>)
summary: Something that happened to a session's history (see the module docstring for the kinds).

name: SessionObserver
summary: A plugin's observer of sessions: ``handle(event)`` is called for every ``SessionEvent``.

name: views_frame
summary: One of the object's views as a DataFrame: the first table by default, or a view by name (the tabs of its window; case does not matter). ``views.titles(obj)`` lists them.

name: walk_eviews_expression
summary: A tree's nodes, the root first, then each child's in order.

name: Widget
signature: Widget(kind, source=None, help='', label='', depends_on=None, multiple=False, show_if=None, group='', min=None, max=None, step=None, advanced=False, exclude=(), empty='')
summary: How a field appears in a form.

name: Workspace
signature: Workspace(key, title, menus, docks, tools, tip)
summary: A stage of the work on the app's stage bar: its menus, panels and tool shortcuts.
